column3: Kuroneko Route · The Noise of the Cyber City
L-Lied about what?
About showing up at our meeting point by coincidence.
...Oh well. So you saw through it.
Of course, did you think I wouldn't know?
...Nope, it's just as you said, Kuroneko. That excuse was so terrible I got found out in an instant.
Why did you come today?
Because it feels like you've been avoiding me.
Me? Avoiding you?
Eh? Why did you phrased that as a question? Haven't you been avoiding me?
Senpai, I'm not avoiding you or anything like that.
Then was my experience yesterday an illusion?
I'm not avoiding you, I'm just...
I'm just... rejecting you, that's all.
That's... what kind of difference does it make?!
...Am I wrong?
No... Not at all.
Why did you reply like it was so difficult?
Good grief... Hah... I really don't get it...
At any rate, if we continue the conversation like this we'll end up going around in circles.
I'll clear this up before Saori returns.
What is it?
Why... did you say "Don't get involved with me"?
That, you don't need to know. All you have to do is faithfully follow the mission I've bestowed upon you.
Which means keeping quiet and doing as I'm told?
Exactly, don't get involved with me any further... just keep that in mind.
How can I... No... never mind.
...Why did you stop halfway?
You won't change your mind even if I keep bugging you, right?
Which basically means, your heart is wavering.
That's not it... That's not it at all... it's just...
Hmph... it seems that I've overestimated you.
Don't get involved with you... right.
That's right.
Hm? Well... I was just thinking that seems it would be a bit lonely...
There's... something troubling you, right?
But there's nothing I can do to help. I feel useless as a senpai.
......So are you planning on giving up?
Huh? What are you saying? Isn't that what you told me? All I'm doing is respecting your wishes.
Even after all that, why do you sound so bothered by it?
...Kirino is counting on me, so I can't give up that easily.
S-Say something.
Gaaah! Say something, I can't stand this silence anymore!
Or do you just dislike me, and don't want to speak to me?
No... That's not it...
*sigh*... I give up. What should I do about this...
If Kuroneko doesn't say anything, there is no way this conversation will go on... *sigh*...
...I'm sorry, I don't know what I should say at this point in time.
But, I... um...
In short, from what I currently understand...
Kirino was right. Kuroneko doesn't seem to hate me.
But why is she avoiding me? I'll try looking into this.
Just that... I... um...
...I heard about it from Saori.
Are your preparations for Comiket going well?
I've heard about it. Have the preparations for Comiket already entered crunch time?
...It's fine, it's been going along smoothly.
Really? You aren't having any problems at all?
It's really okay, if there were any problems I wouldn't be standing here buying things at a leisurely pace.
That's good to hear. But the recent doujinshis are really impressive. Using these kind of digital tools to make them...
Hmm... I see, then that's good to hear.
Oh? What's wrong, you've stopped talking suddenly.
...Nope, it's nothing.
Why does it feel like her mood has turned sour all of a sudden?
Umm... what about it?
...Actually, never mind, it's nothing.
Oh really... Forget it, you won't reply to my question even if I keep asking.
......That's right.
I know. It's fine, crunch time to prepare for Comiket, right? I've heard it from Saori.
...There's no such thing like that.
Really? There isn't?
It's really all right. With these circumstances, you can't call it hell.
So... You're totally fine?
The preparations for Comiket is going fine. So long as I come to replenish what I need here.
You're referring to that tablet's pen and that ergo-something.
Eh, did I say something strange?
It's better to precisely remember the necessary things around you, senpai.
It's called ergonomics.
